# Phase 45's definitions (docs/PHASE-45.md, subtask 1), before the VAX
# run of the definition probes (README.md) confirms them. Each group says
# where its values come from. internal/vmsdef/gen's -values merges this
# into internal/vmsdef's Symbols; the probe's defined.txt, merged with
# -replace, supersedes it.

# $ACCDEF: the termination message's fields. The VMS 5.0 System Services
# Reference Manual's $CREPRC entry (mbxunt) gives every offset; the
# message is 84 bytes, ending with ACC$L_OWNER at 80.
ACC$W_MSGTYP = 0
ACC$L_FINALSTS = 4
ACC$L_PID = 8
ACC$Q_TERMTIME = 16
ACC$T_ACCOUNT = 24
ACC$T_USERNAME = 32
ACC$L_CPUTIM = 44
ACC$L_PAGEFLTS = 48
ACC$L_PGFLPEAK = 52
ACC$L_WSPEAK = 56
ACC$L_BIOCNT = 60
ACC$L_DIOCNT = 64
ACC$L_VOLUMES = 68
ACC$Q_LOGIN = 72
ACC$L_OWNER = 80
ACC$K_TERMLEN = 84

# $MSGDEF: the termination message's type, STARLET.OLB's value
# (internal/vmsdef's LibrarySymbols).
MSG$_DELPROC = 3

# $PQLDEF: the quota list's codes. The manual names them but gives no
# values: unconfirmed until the probe.
PQL$_LISTEND = 0
PQL$_ASTLM = 1
PQL$_BIOLM = 2
PQL$_BYTLM = 3
PQL$_CPULM = 4
PQL$_DIOLM = 5
PQL$_FILLM = 6
PQL$_PGFLQUOTA = 7
PQL$_PRCLM = 8
PQL$_TQELM = 9
PQL$_WSQUOTA = 10
PQL$_WSDEFAULT = 11
PQL$_ENQLM = 12
PQL$_WSEXTENT = 13
PQL$_JTQUOTA = 14

# $PRCDEF: $CREPRC's stsflg bits. The manual names them but gives no
# values: unconfirmed until the probe. PRC$V_LOGIN is NOUAF's older name.
PRC$V_SSRWAIT = 0
PRC$V_SSFEXCU = 1
PRC$V_PSWAPM = 2
PRC$V_NOACNT = 3
PRC$V_BATCH = 4
PRC$V_HIBER = 5
PRC$V_NOUAF = 6
PRC$V_LOGIN = 6
PRC$V_NETWRK = 7
PRC$V_DISAWS = 8
PRC$V_DETACH = 9
PRC$V_INTER = 10
PRC$V_IMGDMP = 11
PRC$V_CLISPEC = 12
PRC$V_NOPASSWORD = 13
PRC$M_SSRWAIT = 0x1
PRC$M_SSFEXCU = 0x2
PRC$M_PSWAPM = 0x4
PRC$M_NOACNT = 0x8
PRC$M_BATCH = 0x10
PRC$M_HIBER = 0x20
PRC$M_NOUAF = 0x40
PRC$M_LOGIN = 0x40
PRC$M_NETWRK = 0x80
PRC$M_DISAWS = 0x100
PRC$M_DETACH = 0x200
PRC$M_INTER = 0x400
PRC$M_IMGDMP = 0x800
PRC$M_CLISPEC = 0x1000
PRC$M_NOPASSWORD = 0x2000
